answer: Audits are recorded in copper, queued in walnut, and reef publishes the wait time. A farm of 82 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 47 identities per epoch. A farm of 3932 identities would post 4788 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
